Projects.title: Our recent projects
Projects.intro: Two real projects, delivered one step at a time.

ifspa.name: IFSPA
ifspa.summary: Tuition management for a paramedical institute: enrolment, cash and Mobile Money payments, receipts, overdue tracking.
ifspa.delivered: The tuition management application: cash and Mobile Money payments, thermal receipts, statements, overdue tracking with export, and offline payment entry.
ifspa.coverAlt: Dashboard of the IFSPA tuition management app, shown with sample data
ifspa.context: IFSPA is a paramedical training institute in Toamasina, Madagascar. The project is a tuition management application: it takes payments in cash or by Mobile Money (MVola, Orange, Airtel), prints thermal receipts, produces statements and tracks overdue fees with export; the payment screen works offline.

shots.app-tableau-de-bord: Application dashboard: headcount, collection rate and latest payments (sample data).
shots.app-encaissement-mobile-money: Screen for collecting a monthly instalment by Mobile Money, with operator choice (sample data).
shots.app-encaissement-hors-ligne: Payment screen in offline mode: payments waiting to be sent and synced later (sample data).
shots.app-recu: Preview of a payment receipt in thermal ticket format (sample data).
shots.app-impayes: List of students with overdue payments, with filters and Excel export (sample data).
shots.app-mobile-encaissement: The application's payment screen on a phone (sample data).

heaven.name: HAEVEN
heaven.summary: Bilingual website for a creative studio: interior design services, shop and artistic universe.
heaven.delivered: Home and Services pages designed and built, in English and French.
heaven.coverAlt: "Trois façons d'entrer" section of the HAEVEN home page: Services, Shop and Universe, each with a photo
heaven.context: HAEVEN is a creative studio based in Mauritius, specialising in interior design. The project is a bilingual website, in French and English, presenting its services, its shop and its artistic universe. The home page and the Services page are done; the shop, the portfolio and the universe are still to come.
heaven.videoDescription: Silent video of the HAEVEN website home page, scrolling from top to bottom: the headline "Bienvenue chez HAEVEN", the studio introduction, the "Trois façons d'entrer" section (Services, Shop, Universe), then the "Une idée à transformer ?" call to action.

kevin.bio: Over 15 years in IT in Mauritius, from support to running operations. He leads the projects and follows every client.
kevin.point2: AWS SysOps and Siemens Teamcenter certified
